fields.description: Issue includes extensive coverage and commentary on the 1935 hurricane and its impact on World War veterans’ camps in the Florida Keys, criticizing delayed evacuation and government response; reports from a flight and boat trip surveying storm damage; discussion of whether the F.E.C. will rebuild the overseas highway; local political coverage including the Hialeah municipal election and allegations involving a federal savings and loan; a traffic-safety statistics feature on Miami accidents; and regular columns and features including editorials, campus/social chatter, sports and horse-racing notes, advertisements, and the paper’s “Most Attractive Working Girl” contest featuring Evelyn Butler.
